user.title: Analog Meter Reader
user.description: Enter the snapshot URL of the camera pointed at the meter. The next step shows a live preview of that image so you can calibrate the crop box.

crop.title: Crop box calibration
crop.description:
{image_preview}

The image has a coordinate grid overlaid every 50px (orange) - read the digit strip's corner pixels off it. Enter them below and save: you'll see the box highlighted in red on the full image plus a separate crop preview, enlarged the way the AI sees it. Adjust the coordinates until the digits are readable - only then check "Confirm".

error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch a snapshot from the given camera address.
error.invalid_crop: The crop box is empty or extends beyond the image bounds - fix the coordinates.
